overall_notes: The paper focuses on tool-calling behavior evaluation for language models, which involves generating appropriate responses (tool calls or natural language) based on tool availability. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of model names and consolidation of metric variants. The paper introduces a novel benchmark (When2Call) for evaluating when LMs should/shouldn't call tools.
